matched_variant_raw.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
matched_variant_raw.rewritten_question_text:
In general, the density of air is negatively correlated with temperature and the water vapor content in the air. The figure below shows the terrain and 8 o'clock temperature conditions cross-section of a certain region in the mid-latitudes of the Northern Hemisphere; the air flow near the ground flows from west to east, and the speed is 20 kilometers/hour throughout. Answer according to this:

<image1>

At this time, among places Jia, Yi, and Bing, which place has the most stable vertical atmospheric condition?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In general, the density of air is negatively correlated with temperature and the water vapor content in the air. The figure below shows the terrain and 8 o'clock temperature conditions cross-section of a certain region in the mid-latitudes of the Northern Hemisphere; the air flow near the ground flows from west to east, and the speed is 20 kilometers/hour throughout. Answer according to this: <image1> At this time, among places Jia, Yi, and Bing, which place has the most stable vertical atmospheric condition?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a west-east terrain and 8 o'clock temperature cross-section; the horizontal direction represents distance, and the vertical direction represents altitude. There is a lake in the middle of the ground surface; Jia is located near the lowland on the west side of the lake, Yi is located near the east side of the lake, and Bing is located in a lowland farther to the east. The figure has isotherms such as 0℃, 3℃, 6℃, 9℃, 12℃, 15℃, and 18℃, and the vertical distances among the 9℃, 12℃, 15℃, and 18℃ isotherms above Bing on the right side are relatively large. Then reason: Judging atmospheric vertical stability mainly depends on how fast temperature decreases with height; above the same place, the larger the vertical spacing between isotherms, the smaller the vertical lapse rate of temperature, and warm air near the ground is less likely to rise strongly, so the atmosphere is more stable. Comparing the air above Jia, Yi, and Bing, the spacing between isotherms over Bing is the largest, and temperature decreases slowest with height, so at this time the vertical atmospheric condition at Bing is the most stable.
